# TraceQL queries for the lexer tests and the Tempo oracle (tempo_test.go).
# Each line is a tag and a query:
#   ok       the lexer accepts it and Tempo runs it, unscoped and scoped
#   invalid  the lexer accepts it and Tempo rejects it
#   reject   the lexer rejects it
# The oracle scopes queries to svc-a; the seeded traces are described in dev/seed-traces.sh.
